REWORK ITERATION 1: Fix 6 remaining E2E test failures for Stage F2. 7 tests now pass, 6 fail.

REMAINING FAILURES:

1. TC-PDUI02-02 (typo): Test uses `def` instead of `draftDef` variable. Fix the variable reference in the test file.

2. TC-PDUI03-01 & TC-PDUI03-04 (version history): Tests expect clicking a definition name to expand an inline version history row with data-testid='version-history-row'. Currently the component uses <Link> navigation to the editor page. Change approach: implement inline expand/collapse for version history in DefinitionListPage.tsx. When clicking the definition name, toggle an expanded section below the row showing version list fetched from the API. Add loading state for the version fetch.

3. TC-PDUI04-02 (disabled submit button): Test fills name and version fields, then clicks submit. But the button has HTML `disabled` attribute when fields are empty. Instead of using disabled attribute, use client-side validation that shows error messages when submitting empty fields. Remove the disabled attribute and show inline validation.

4. TC-PDUI04-03 (POST error): Debug why POST /definitions returns an error. The backend now accepts graph as optional. Check the error response and fix either frontend or backend.

5. TC-PDUI01-03 (search returns no results): Verify the search functionality works end-to-end.

Validation:
cd web
npm run type-check
npm run lint
npm run build
All must exit 0.

Commit and push to feature/WF03-f2a-e2e-fix-20260528.
